column1: table s37: trends in percentage of adults who felt very/fairly safe walking alone after dark, by sex, year ending december 1994 to year ending march 2019 csew
Source: Office for National Statistics - Crime Survey for England and Wales
1. From the year ending March 2013 onwards the question was only asked of a quarter of the sample.
2. Questionnaire changes in the year ending March 2013 may mean that estimates prior to this date are not comparable with subsequent years due to potential order effects.
3. The question of feeling safe walking alone after dark was not asked in the year ending March 2017 questionnaire.
4. The unweighted base refers to the number of adults who were asked the question on feeling safe walking alone after dark.
